title: thymus serpyllum f. glaber
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. glaber, commonly known as creeping thyme or glabrous thyme, is a flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thymus serpyllum f. glaber include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which may aid in relieving coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include thymol, carvacrol, and ursolic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
